testcase.name: Back from a draft opened out of the drafts list returns to the list, and Back again returns to Entries
touching the floating button at several points starts a new entry each time, never the card beneath it
scrolled to the end, the album's last photos sit clear of Add photo and open at a touch at several points
the view toggle shows timeline and album with timeline on, and the Album sub-tab is gone
the album badges each photo by what it is attached to - a journal entry, a find, both, or neither
scrolled to the end, the last cards sit clear of the floating button and take touches at several points
Back from Records steps to Entries
Back from the album returns to the timeline
with one draft, touching Continue at several points opens that draft in the editor
the switch shows Entries and Records, Entries selected, and no Cartography label
touching Add photo at several points opens the menu, never the photo beneath it, and Take photo at several points opens the album's camera
touching album at several points shows the album, and touching timeline brings the entries back
touching each side of the switch at several points switches between Entries and Records
the drafts list's back arrow, touched at several points, returns to Entries
the album has an Add photo floating button, and the album's own Camera and Import row is gone
with three drafts the banner reads 3 unfinished entries
with no drafts there is no banner
finishing a draft opened from the list returns to the list while drafts remain, and to Entries when none do
a draft picked from the list by a touch at several points opens that draft in the editor
with several drafts, touching Continue at several points opens the full-screen drafts list, and Back returns to Entries
Import in the Add photo menu, touched at several points, launches the system photo picker
the timeline has a New entry floating button in place of the plus tile
with one draft the banner reads 1 unfinished entry with Continue, and the Drafts sub-tab is gone
each album badge carries a content description a screen reader reads
the album groups photos by day, newest day first and unknown dates last, in 3 columns with 3 dp gaps
